Let's parse: It's a tolyl (para methyl) phenyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide linking to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-methyl phenyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl which has a trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH (actually amide attached to aniline? Wait: C(=O)N c3ccccc3N: that's an amide where the nitrogen is attached to phenyl that also has an NH (aniline). So the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl which also has an NH substituent (maybe an aniline). So overall three disconnections: 1) amide formation between acrylic acid (or unsaturated acid) and aniline (with NH). 2) Doebner modification to form the α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. 3) sulfonamide formation between sulfonyl chloride (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the phenyl with the unsaturated amide). Actually sulfonamide formation: the sulfonyl chloride derived from p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride reacting with aniline (the phenyl bearing the unsaturated amide). So retrosynthesis steps:

Target -> disconnect amide: break C(=O)-N bond to give unsaturated acid (C=CH-COOH) attached to phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor 1: trans-α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl (c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Actually the amide is C(=O)N-Ph-NH? Wait: C(=O)N c3ccccc3N means carbonyl attached to N which is attached to phenyl that also has an NH substituent (maybe at para?). The SMILES: C(=O)N c3ccccc3N . So the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl which also has an NH (aniline). So the amide precursor is the unsaturated acid plus the aniline (with NH). So step 1: amide coupling.

Step 2: The unsaturated acid can be made via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(C=O)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So precursor: aromatic aldehyde (p-tolyl? Actually the phenyl attached to sulfonyl is c2ccc(... )cc2, with substituent /C=C/COOH. So the aldehyde would be c2ccc(C=O)cc2 (para unsubstituted). So step 2: Doebner modification.

Step 3: Sulfonamide formation: sulfonyl chloride derived from p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (p-methyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride) reacting with aniline (the phenyl bearing the unsaturated acid). So precursor: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-Ph-CH3) and the aniline (the phenyl with unsaturated acid). So overall three steps.
